events.title: US-Japan Joint Yen Intervention - First Since 1998
events.source: Reuters, CNBC, Japan Times, Al Jazeera
events.summary: US Treasury and Japan MOF conducted coordinated yen-buying intervention on July 31. First US-Japan joint intervention since 1998. Bessent note: Buy Japanese Yen $5-10 bil.

events.title: Strait of Hormuz Crisis - Iran War Day 161, Strait Still Closed
events.source: ISW, Wikipedia, IranSITREP, Britannica, Al Jazeera
events.summary: Strait of Hormuz remains closed as of Aug 7 1600 UTC. Iran parliament reviewing bill to ban US/Israeli vessels. US-Iran strikes ongoing since June. Iran targeting energy infrastructure across Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman.

events.title: Ebola Epidemic - WHO PHEIC Declared, 3,973 Cases, 1,801 Deaths
events.summary: Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in DRC declared WHO PHEIC on May 16. 3,973 confirmed cases, 1,801 deaths, 674 hospitalized. Spread to Uganda (2 deaths). No vaccine for Bundibugyo strain.

events.title: China Real Estate Crash - Nationwide Economic Emergency, 10 Quarters of Deflation
events.source: Chiang Rai Times, The Tribune, Epoch Times
events.summary: China property crash described as nationwide economic emergency. S&P expects 1.5-2.5% primary price drops, 4-5% secondary drops in 2026. 10 straight quarters of falling prices. PBOC pledging loose monetary policy.

events.title: France Fiscal Crisis - EUR107B H1 Deficit, Potential 8% Deficit Ratio
events.source: Futunn, The Corner, ECB Economic Bulletin
events.summary: France central government deficit EUR107B in H1 2026, 14.4% higher than prior year. Full-year deficit ratio potentially 8%. Called new epicenter of Eurozone debt crisis. ECB keeping rates at 2.25%, markets pricing 40bps of hikes.

events.title: OPEC+ Completes Production Cut Rollback - 188K BPD Increase in September
events.summary: OPEC+ seven members agreed to boost collective target by 188,000 bpd in September, completing phased rollback of 2023 voluntary cuts. Oil at $78-82/bbl, up 22% YoY.
